SIKADUR®-55 SLV: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikadur®-55 SLV, June 2024, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/sikadur_-55_slv.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikadur®-55 SLV where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2024, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. Sikadur® 55 SLV is a 2-component, 100% solids, moisture-tolerant, epoxy crack healer / penetrating sealer, having a fast tack-free time to minimize downtime. It is a super low-viscosity, high-strength adhesive formulated specifically for sealing both dry and damp cracks. It conforms to the current ASTM C-881, Types I and II, Grade-1, Class-C* and AASHTO M-235 specifications. * except for gel time
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikadur®-55 SLV may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - � Sikadur 55 SLV structurally repairs cracked concrete.
    - � For interior slabs and exterior above-grade slabs.
    - � For elevated horizontal decks, parking garages and other structures exposed to foot and pneumatic tire traffic.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikadur®-55 SLV
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Super low-viscosity, moisture-tolerant epoxy resin, crack healer / penetrating sealer
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - Meets Vic Roads Spec Section 687- Repair of Concrete Cracks
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - � Super low viscosity/low surface tension for excellent penetration into cracks.
    - � Penetrates cracks by gravity down to 0.05 mm in width.
    - � Prolongs life of cracked concrete.
    - � Penetrates/seals surface of slabs from water absorption, chloride-ion intrusion, and chemical attack.
    - � Structurally improves concrete surface.
    - � Can be open to traffic in 6 hours at 23°C.
    - � High bond strength, even in damp cracks.
    - � U.S. Patent No. for ultra-low viscosity healer/sealer to strengthen cracked concrete.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Colour: Clear, Amber
    - Density: 1.1 kg / litre approx.
    - Viscosity: ~105 cps @ 23oC
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: 2,068 MPa at 7 days
    - Flexural-strength: 58.6 MPa at days (ASTM D – 790)
    - Modulus of elasticity in flexure: 2,206 MPa at 7 days (ASTM D – 790)
    - Tensile strength: 48.9 MPa at 7 days (ASTM D – 638)
    - Tensile strain at break: 10% (ASTM D – 638)
    - Shear strength: 40.0 MPa at 7 days (ASTM D - 732)
    - Heat deflection temperature: 43°C (ASTM D - 648)
    - Water absorption: 0.60% (ASTM D - 570)

2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 11.3 Litre kit.
    - Shelf life: 2 years in original, unopened containers.
    - Storage conditions: Store dry at 4o - 35oC. Condition material to 18o - 24oC before using..

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2024, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2024, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Component 'A' : Component 'B' = 2 : 1 by volume
    - Consumption: 3.7 to 4.3 m² / litre for surface sealing.
    - Pot Life: ~20 minutes
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - � Do not thin. Addition of solvents will prevent proper cure.
    - � Material is a vapour barrier after cure.
    - � Do not apply if rain is imminent. Water exposure or humidity will affect surface appearance and may cause surface whitening.
    - � Not an aesthetic product. Colour may alter due to variations in lighting and/or UV exposure.
    - � Sealed concrete surface may appear blotchy due to differential absorption.
    - � Allow sufficient time for the substrate to dry after rain or other inclement conditions.
    - � Application temperature of substrate must be minimum 3°C above the dew point.
    - � Minimum ambient and substrate temperature 4°C. Maximum application temperature 35°C.
    - � Do not inject cracks greater than 6 mm Consult Technical Service.
    - � Minimum age of concrete is 21-28 days, depending on curing and drying conditions.
    - � Not designed to seal or inject cracks under hydrostatic pressure during application.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.3):
    - � Do not apply if rain is imminent. Water exposure or humidity will affect surface appearance and may cause surface whitening.
    - � Allow sufficient time for the substrate to dry after rain or other inclement conditions.
    - � Application temperature of substrate must be minimum 3°C above the dew point.
    - � Minimum ambient and substrate temperature 4°C. Maximum application temperature 35°C.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Flexural-strength: 58.6 MPa at days (ASTM D – 790)
    - Modulus of elasticity in flexure: 2,206 MPa at 7 days (ASTM D – 790)
    - Tensile strength: 48.9 MPa at 7 days (ASTM D – 638)
    - Tensile strain at break: 10% (ASTM D – 638)
    - Shear strength: 40.0 MPa at 7 days (ASTM D - 732)
    - Tensile adhesion strength: 2 days | 17.2 MPa; 14 days | 17.2 MPa; Hardened Concrete to; Steel; 2 days | 10.3 MPa; 14 days | 11.0 MPa; Hardened Concrete to; Hardened Concrete (ASTM C - 882) (ASTM C - 882)
    - Heat deflection temperature: 43°C (ASTM D - 648)
    - Water absorption: 0.60% (ASTM D - 570)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikadur®-55 SLV, June 2024, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/sikadur_-55_slv.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikadur®-55 SLV Part A, version 08/07/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sds-sikadur-55-slvparta.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikadur®-55 SLV Part B, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/t/sds-sikadur-55-slvpartb.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Substrate preparation. Substrate must be clean, sound and free of surface moisture. Remove dust, laitance, grease, oils, curing compounds, waxes, impregnations, foreign particles, coatings and disintegrated materials by mechanical means (i.e. shotblasting, sandblasting, etc.). For best results, substrate should be dry. Surfaces prepared by Low Pressure Water Cleaning or High Pressure Water Jetting methods should be allowed to dry for 24 hrs. minimum 23°C.
6.4 Ecology, health and safety - Mixing. Mix 1 part Component ‘B’ to 2 parts Component ‘A’ by volume into a clean pail. Mix thoroughly for 3 minutes with Sika paddle or jiffy mixer on a lowspeed (400-600 rpm) drill until uniformly blended. Mix only that quantity which can be used within its pot life.
6.5 Ecology, health and safety - Application method / tools. To gravity feed cracks: Sikadur 55 SLV is applied to horizontal surfaces by flat squeegee or broom. Spread material over area and allow to pond over cracks. Let material penetrate into cracks and substrate. Remove excess epoxy with roller leaving no visible surface film. For cracks greater than 3 mm wide, fill crack with oven-dried sand before applying Sikadur 55 SLV. Seal cracks from underside, when accessible, to prevent leakage. A second treatment may be required on very porous substrates. Apply second treatment before broadcasting. After treatment, wait at least 20 minutes at 23°C. Cover with broadcast of an oven-dried 20/40 silica sand or similar sand. Distribute evenly over the surface to excess at a rate of 1.5-2.0 kg/m2. Allow to cure 6 hours minimum at 23°C. Remove any loose sand and open to traffic once epoxy has cured.
6.6 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.7 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.8 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
